reviews.text: Our adult rescue dog started to become reactive afterva few months. She became aggressive to strangers, humans and dogs, where she was originally friendly. We took her to two trainers and a dog psychologist over the first few years, with some improvement but overall, still reactive and stressful for all of us. Eventually took her to Mellow Vibes where she stayed for 5 weeks. The improvement was amazing on her return home. Although we can never fully trust her to not react to strangers, so muzzle or tether her around strangers, she listens to our direction to sit and stop barking, if someone comes to the door or enters the house. She no longer reacts to strange dogs or people on the street. It has been a few years since her stay with MellowVibes. We are not as consistent as we should be leading her, when we walk, yet she reverts quickly back listening to our direction. Our dog was happy to see us after her training, but she seemed relaxed and well cared for when we picked her up and on update videos. Definitely recommend for loving but reactive pets.

We sent our 5 year old schnoodle for board and train a few months ago. We are so pleased with the results!

Our dog had a lot of anxiety - he would shake at home for reasons we couldn't figure out, he would pace around when we had guests over, and would follow us around the house. Listening to our commands was hit or miss.

Since getting trained, our dog has changed so much. He learned the basic commands and listens to us. He chills in his bed when guests are around, he doesn't shake or follow us around the house.

Highly recommend Mellow Vibes. You won't be disappointed.

It was worth every cent! As a first time foster for a rescue dog, I had a lot to learn, and Paul was incredibly patient with me during our 1:1 session. He took the time to understand my level of experience and tailored his training approach that was easy for me to follow and build confidence in. He was accommodative and even extended our session to make sure I felt comfortable and confident in the new skills I had learned. He didn't end his support after the session. He continued checking in with me afterwards to make sure things were progressing well and to offer guidance when needed.

Paul genuinely cares about both his clients and their dogs. I’m grateful for his help and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, kind, and dedicated trainer. Cookie (my dog) and I are grateful for his training. We learned to build and respect boundaries and have a harmonious relationship.

Thank you to Boysie and Paul for doing an amazing job with our Havanese puppy, Wally! Wally spent 3 weeks at Mellow Vibes and was transformed from a stubborn little guy to an absolute joy. He knows all his commands and is so much calmer now. Thank you!
This is our second time working with the experts at Mellow Vibes. The results are consistent with our first experience. Our pup is joyous and very well trained and socialized. Highly recommend !

Navy spent three weeks there for training, and we are very happy with the results. She learned to sit reliably and walk calmly on leash, even when seeing other dogs, which was a huge goal for us.
They were very attuned to her personality and quickly recognized the specific areas where she needed extra support and structure. They tailored her training accordingly and always seemed one step ahead in anticipating what needed to be done. Throughout her stay, it was clear that they took excellent care of her, treating her like their own dog and maintaining a safe environment. She played with their own dog Kata.  You can tell they take a lot of pride in their work and genuinely care.
We would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for thoughtful, effective, and compassionate help with their dog.

Our just turned 12 year old Standard Schnauzer was brought to Mellow Vibes due to severe anxiety and aggression towards children which worsened as he aged, along with some reactivity  towards other dogs and scooters. Out of concern for our grandchildren we knew something had to be done. Mellow Vibes transformed him into a calm and friendly dog among children/infants, scooters and other dogs, we are forever grateful!

Mellow Vibes truly worked magic on our stubborn 2-month-old Goldendoodle! As first-time puppy parents, we were overwhelmed and thought training would be easier — until we met Paul and his wonderful family. They’re so kind, patient, and genuinely love what they do. Our pup now listens, follows commands, and behaves so well. We feel completely confident leaving her with them whenever we travel. It’s a loving, family-run business where every dog is treated like their own. Highly recommend Mellow Vibes! 🐾❤️

I’m so happy with the training my puppy Bentley received from everyone at Mellow Vibes. He’s such a smart dog, and I get so many compliments on how well behaved he is wherever we go. The training was positive, effective, and really made a difference. I couldn’t be happier with the results and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great dog trainer.

I left Bear with Paul for five weeks and Bear came back a completely different dog. Everyone from friends to family who had witnessed Bear’s reactivity with other dogs were blown away by how easy he is now to walk. Paul also taught me how to be a different kind of dog parent, and the subtle changes in our relationship improved our quality of life dramatically. Obviously I’ve always loved my dog, but I can sense he actually respects me now, and our bond has actually deepened. I used to be scared of taking Bear anywhere — now I take him on my coffee runs and to the parks, and can walk him during doggie rush hour, which I never would have imagined possible. I’ve used another trainer before and just accepted that Bear was a hopeless case. Mellow Vibes was a last ditch effort — my only regret is not finding it sooner.

I cannot express how Mellow Vibes has contributed to quality of life in the past fee months.
I had unfortunate timing when I found out that my knee replacement surgery was going to be scheduled two weeks after I picked up my Oakley. Needless to say I was in a panic but I contacted Paul at Mello and he was understanding compassionate and accommodating after hearing my story.
Anyway, I had the surgery and Oakley was with Paul for three weeks training and boarding.
I did not know what to expect when I went for the train the owner session however I was extremely pleased, surprised and excited to see the transition of my Boy. He was well trained,  obedient and confident.  And as I was still using a walking stick his transformation was a game changer for both of us.
I still take advantage of Mellow's continous (no charge) follow ups.
I  frequently also use their daycare services.
These Guys are the best!!!

We couldn't be happier with the transformation in our 3-year-old rescue, Stevie! She came to us with anxiety-driven reactivity toward other dogs, plus a high prey drive that had her chasing our cat and fixating on every squirrel in sight.

After a month with Paul at Mellow Vibes, she's like a different dog - calm, confident, and so much happier now that she understands what's expected of her. She can pass other dogs much more calmly, has better recall, and can be in the same space as the cat largely without incident.

She's kept all her lovable quirks and affectionate personality while becoming much more obedient. If you're dealing with reactivity or behavioural issues, we definitely recommend Mellow Vibes.

Our dog Rocky is a golden doodle.  He is six turning seven and I took him to Paul as a last resort. I started thinking that I would have to rehome him. He was never an aggressive dog, he just wasn’t always very obedient.  He just stopped listening to me and I couldn’t walk him anymore and he started counter surfing and just not gelling with my family.   After spending four weeks with Paul and his family, we have a brand new improved dog. He came back with his same silly personality, but he now respects me and our daughter. We are able to walk him without him lunging at other dogs/bikes/humans. He doesn’t bark when we leave the house.  People can enter our house without him, jumping all over them.  He now gives us the ball when playing.  I can’t think Paul and the team enough. We still have work to do within our house and reminding Rocky who is boss. But now my daughter can walk him. I can walk him and I really enjoy being with him all of the time.  With a few tweaks from Paul, we now have the dog we’ve always wanted.  Thank you.

Paul, and his team did such an amazing job with our three month old puppy. He was very hyper and showing dominance before we brought him to Mellow vibes. After the two week training, he came back, calm, less anxious, no barking and so much more obedient. We also knew he had such a fun time there because we were getting updates of him playing with other dogs and he wasn’t even really excited to see us😅I can’t recommend them enough!

Dropped our puppy off for training for 2 weeks and it was a game changer!! Noticed massive differences in his demeanour and calmness with us and in the house. Totally worth the investment to have the help set us up for having our boy Wally for a long time!! Thanks again!!

Paul is a fantastic trainer that helped us address behavioural challenges that we had with our 6 year old terrier mix. Our main concerns were with reactivity to sounds in the apartment hallway, to other dogs on walks, and pulling on the leash. There were also sproadic incidences of what seemed to be resource guarding and dominance that we made him aware of so that he could observe and address them as well.

The process began with a phone consultation where we explained our concerns to Paul and he asked probing questions to understand the severity of the situation and to learn about our relationship with our dog. Through this assessment, he explained how our habits allowed our dog to feel that they were in charge and we would need to reset that mindset. It was determined that the reactivity training would take approximately 3-4 weeks and potentially extended if he felt that more time would be required. Paul offered to send us pictures and videos upon request during the training and provided updates on our dog's progress when we followed up. At the end of the term, Paul sat down with us for about 3 hours to review recordings from his training and shared guidance on the teachings that we had to carry forward with our dog. It was stressed that the corrections that he had made were only as good as our consistency in keeping those same processes. After taking our dog home, we noticed some immediate changes. She was pulling less on the leash and walked beside us instead of in front. This could have been attributed to the fact that she was now on a prong collar and had a muzzle, but the tools were ultimately part of the changes that helped us with corrections. At home, she was also not reacting to noises in the hallway anymore which was amazing. Paul followed up with us every other day or so in the following weeks to check in on our dog and addressed any questions we had which we appreciated.

We had a great experience overall with Paul and the new behaviours he had instilled in our dog. His guidance was invaluable and we feel empowered to be able to continue shaping a positive relationship with our dog.

Paul was wonderful to work with! He was very understanding of our needs and recommended we do one session with him. He carefully explained the training methodology and answered all our questions. And the training has worked wonders!

My family and I had a great experience meeting with Paul to gain some insight into our dogs situation regarding aggression and how to implement tactics to help us. Within one day of doing the things Paul taught us, we already noticed a difference in their behaviours. Paul was friendly, experienced, and answered all of our questions. I would definitely recommend him to others.

We took our 3 year old golden doodle, Jack, to Mellow Vibes for some minor behavioural challenges that were becoming more frustrating. From our initial phone consultation we became very optimistic that Paul could help us. He identified that barking at the door and pulling on the leash were signs that Jack thought of himself as above us in the hierarchy of the household. He then named a few other behaviours that supported the same theory, all of which Jack did. Jack was with them for just over 3 weeks and we missed him dearly, but it was very reassuring to know they were thorough with his training so we would see the results we hoped for.

He seemed quite happy there, with lots of play and social time, it was clear they care deeply for the dogs. Mellow Vibes knows dog behaviour- it is amazing what they are able to accomplish with dog training and how they taught us to continue the dynamic. The training is very holistic, they address all sorts of behaviours as they learn more about the dog. Jack came home with a renewed confidence in social settings and generally seems less unsure of new people and dogs. As Paul said, the things they taught us were not difficult, but many were not intuitive and it really helped to have a fresh start where we were on the same page as Jack about expectations.

We learned so much from Paul and Boysie at our pickup training session and received very attentive continued support as we readjusted to life at home. It’s been incredibly valuable to be able to text any questions as we navigate new situations. We feel like we understand Jack now and the ways our communication was confusing him. He is an absolute joy to walk, he no longer pulls or scavenges, and he seems much more content. We can’t recommend Mellow Vibes enough- they know exactly what they’re doing and have a system that works. And they are wonderfully kind caring people who want dogs to live lives free from anxiety and confusion.

My neighbour recommended Mellow Vibes to train our chow chow puppy. We were new to the dog world and had no idea how to train her. She was cute but she ruled our house! She pulled on walks, grabbed food, jumped on us, and chased our cat.

After her time at Mellow Vibes she was calm and obedient. The change was dramatic! We were worried we would be unable to maintain the obedience. However, with their guidance, she has continued to be a happy, calm chow. The best part: my young daughter can easily take her for walks.

With a busy family, we are grateful for their help training our dog.

Mellow Vibes is experienced and knowledgeable. The instructions are clear and communication and professionalism is top notch. My dog has transformed her behavior from just one focused session that gave our family the tools to create the environment she needed. I recommend them wholeheartedly!

Paul was an incredible trainer for our 4 year old miniature golden doodle (Cain) who needed proper training for her reactivity with other dogs and general obedience (Cain thought she was the leader of the house). She did the board and train program for ~4 weeks and came home a more relaxed, trustworthy, and obedient dog. Paul gave us the right tools and techniques to continue the training at home. We continue to have phone calls with Paul when we have questions or aren’t sure how to train in specific situations. Thank you Paul for all of your help!!

I welcomed home a border collie when he was 2.5 months old earlier this year but had already had plans to travel for 3 weeks outside of country after that, so I was looking for a dog trainer who can take him in and do some obedience training while I was away for 3 weeks at least. I knew I likely needed professional help with training my border collie from my sister who jokingly told me her female border collie almost gave her a nerve breakdown despite that she was considered somewhat calm for a border collie. My pup is super adorable and was always happy to be around people, however, he was quite aggressive toward dogs in a way that he would not stop barking once he catches a dog within his sight, let alone playing with other dogs was completely unthinkable as he would growl and try to bite back whenever a dog comes near him. On top of that, he was somehow afraid of entering and exiting my condo building and could never leave my building unless I put him in a kennel and carry him outside. He would try chase after people and excessively scream and cry when I stopped him. Although potting training went well, I was struggling with teaching other basic commands as he would not listen to me and get easily distracted. After finding out about Mellow Vibes, I immediately contacted and Paul scheduled a brief meet and greet. He graciously gave me some tips about training my puppy and thoroughly addressed all the questions I had about training my pup as well as their boarding and training program, which all made good sense to me. After I went pick up my pup 3.5 weeks after, he was totally a changed dog. He would walk to heels with no issue, listen to my commands such as sit, down and stay as well as some other tricks, and just sit there waiting to be petted without acting up. He can now calmly say hi to other dogs and play with them without being aggressive. The most important part I have learned from Mellow Vibes is that all dog owners need to be equipped with the right kind of knowledge and skillsets personalized for their dog's unique personality and behavior and keep up with training at all times. Paul and his family genuinely care about how you and your doggie can build a healthy and loving relationship that lasts your (or most likely doggie's ) lifetime. I believe that's why Paul always respondsl timely to whatever question or concern I have about my pup and his advice always works! For all the dog parents out there who need help, I would recommend in a heartbeat reaching out to Mellow Vibes for whatever is keeping you up at night because of your darling doggie :)
